title: The Chymistry of Isaac Newton
author: Isaac Newton
institution: Indiana University (William R. Newman, general editor; John A. Walsh, technical editor)
notes: Online edition of Newton's alchemical manuscripts from Cambridge and other libraries, each shown in a normalised and a diplomatic transcription (encoded in TEI/XML, but the XML is not offered for download), with English translations of non-English passages, glossary and analysis tools. Newton wrote and copied about one million words on alchemy; the site's browse list holds 73 manuscripts, which is the count given (our own count of the browse pages; some are Newton's copies of older texts). Words not given. The Oxford Newton Project is a separate resource. Pages show an update stamp of 2025-07-03.
